notes: Bitwarden's password manager for Android, on Google Play as com.x8bit.bitwarden and clearly designed rather than assembled: :ui is a first-class design-system module (BitwardenActionCard, BitwardenStatusBadge, BitwardenRowOfActions, the button and text-field family) with 43 preview-bearing files in ui/src/main/kotlin. Ordinary Android Compose, Robolectric lane, a single Gradle build at the repository root, and a module that depends on no network or vault code — the least eventful of this batch to import, which is why it is worth having beside the multiplatform ones.
